name: What preparation is needed before tiling a basement floor?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before tiling a basement floor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper preparation is critical for a durable basement tile installation. First, the subfloor must be clean, dry, and free of debris. Any existing flooring needs to be removed. Next, the floor must be level; self-leveling compounds may be used to address uneven surfaces. A moisture test is essential to identify any potential dampness issues. If moisture is present, a suitable vapor barrier or waterproofing membrane will be installed to prevent future problems like efflorescence or adhesive failure, which is common in Bay Area basements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Basement tile preparation involves cleaning, leveling the subfloor, and conducting moisture tests. A vapor barrier may be needed if moisture is present.
